Wii Party (native) - controls
=============================

One player per device. The keyboard and mouse are player 1. Every gamepad you plug in
(Xbox, PlayStation, Switch) is the next player: the first is player 2, then 3, then 4.
A player with no device is treated as a Remote that isn't connected.

Player 1: keyboard and mouse
  Pointer       Mouse (or the arrow keys once the mouse has been still for 3 seconds)
  A             Left click, Enter, Space
  B             Right click, Backspace, Right Ctrl
  A+B together  Middle click, Tab
  Up/Down/
  Left/Right    Arrow keys
  1 / 2         1 / 2
  + / -         = / -
  HOME          H
  Shake         Right Shift

Players 2-4: gamepad
  A / Cross = A, B / Circle = B, X = 1, Y = 2, Start = +, Back = -, Guide = HOME,
  D-pad = D-pad, right stick = pointer, left stick = tilt, left shoulder = shake,
  right shoulder = B.

F1   Switches the arrow keys between "pointing at the screen" and "Remote held sideways".
     Most minigames hold the Remote sideways; press F1 when up/down/left/right feel turned.
     The title bar shows which mode is on.
F11  Full screen on/off.

The title bar also shows the frame rate.

Launcher: double-click "Wii Party.bat" to pick the disc folder, upscale, screen shape,
full screen and player 1 keys, then press Play. Settings are kept in settings.ini.
